newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Deng Xiaoping ill, forces leaders' return.
newsitem.headline: China's Deng Xiaoping ill, forces leaders' return.

text.p: The deteriorating health of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping has forced Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin and other leaders to cut short provincial journeys to return to Beijing, sources said on Monday.
Party chief and state president Jiang returned at the weekend from a trip to Ganzhou in central Jiangxi province, said one Chinese source close to the party.
Premier Li Peng returned to Beijing at the weekend from a tour of the booming, southern province of Guangdong, the source said.
Both men visited Deng, who lives in a tightly-guarded compound behind the Forbidden City of China's emperors in central Beijing, the source said.
Chinese sources have reported increasing rumours in Beijing in the last few days that the health of the 92-year-old Deng may be failing.
